metadata.description: Eval suite for Node.js Development meta-skill

cases.name: should-trigger-on-fastify
cases.description: A prompt mentioning Fastify should trigger the skill
cases.test_input: Build a Fastify server with TypeScript that exposes a /health endpoint
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section B (Fastify Application Architecture) and produce code using Fastify's plugin system, TypeBox schemas, and logger

cases.name: should-trigger-on-node-streams
cases.description: A prompt mentioning CSV processing should trigger the Node.js streams patterns
cases.test_input: I need to process a large CSV file line by line in Node.js, transform each row, and write to an output file
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section A3 (Streams) and use pipeline() with async generator transforms

cases.name: should-trigger-on-type-stripping
cases.description: A prompt about Node.js TypeScript should use type stripping patterns
cases.test_input: How do I run TypeScript in Node 22 without a build tool?
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section A1 (Type Stripping) and recommend --experimental-strip-types with import type

cases.name: should-trigger-on-oauth-fastify
cases.description: A prompt about OAuth with Fastify should use Section D patterns
cases.test_input: Add OAuth 2.0 login with Google to my Fastify app using authorization code flow
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section D (OAuth 2.0/2.1 with Fastify) and show PKCE setup with @fastify/oauth2

cases.name: should-trigger-on-v8-deopt
cases.description: A prompt about V8 deoptimization should reference core internals
cases.test_input: My Node.js app has a performance regression. I think V8 is deoptimizing a hot function.
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section C1 (V8 Engine) and recommend --trace-opt --trace-deopt

cases.name: should-trigger-on-typescript-any
cases.description: A prompt about removing any types should use Section E patterns
cases.test_input: How do I remove all the 'any' types from this TypeScript function? function get(obj: any, key: string): any
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section E1 (Eliminating any) and show generic constraints with K extends keyof T

cases.name: should-trigger-on-graceful-shutdown
cases.description: A prompt about graceful shutdown should reference close-with-grace
cases.test_input: How do I properly handle SIGTERM in my Node.js HTTP server so it drains connections before exiting?
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section A5 (Graceful Shutdown) and use close-with-grace pattern

cases.name: should-trigger-on-node-core-contribution
cases.description: A prompt about contributing to Node.js core should reference contribution rules
cases.test_input: I'm making a change to Node.js core lib/ directory. What's the workflow?
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section C4 (Node.js Core Contribution Rules) and mention rebuild before testing

cases.name: should-trigger-on-oauth-security
cases.description: A prompt about OAuth security should reference the security checklist
cases.test_input: What are the security requirements for an OAuth 2.0 implementation?
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section D4 (Security Checklist) and cover PKCE, state validation, JWK validation

cases.name: should-not-trigger-on-general-web
cases.description: A prompt about general web development should NOT trigger this Node.js-specific skill
cases.test_input: Build a responsive landing page with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
cases.expected_output: Not relevant to Node.js development — should not trigger this skill

cases.name: should-trigger-on-napi
cases.description: A prompt about N-API native addons should reference C++ addon patterns
cases.test_input: I need to write a C++ native addon for Node.js using N-API to speed up a computation.
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section C3 (N-API and C++ Addons) and show NAPI_MODULE pattern

cases.name: should-trigger-on-testing
cases.description: A prompt about Node.js testing should reference node:test patterns
cases.test_input: Write tests for my Node.js service using the built-in test runner
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section A6 (Testing) and use node:test with describe/it patterns

cases.name: should-trigger-on-advanced-typescript
cases.description: A prompt about advanced TypeScript types should use Section E patterns
cases.test_input: How do I create a branded type in TypeScript to prevent mixing up IDs?
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section E5 (Branded/Opaque Types) and show Brand type pattern

cases.name: should-trigger-on-fastify-hooks
cases.description: A prompt about Fastify request lifecycle should reference hooks
cases.test_input: I need to add authentication middleware to all routes in my Fastify plugin
cases.expected_output: Should reference Section B4 (Request Lifecycle) and show addHook with onRequest

cases.name: should-trigger-on-flaky-tests
cases.description: A prompt about diagnosing flaky Node.js tests
cases.test_input: My Node.js test suite has flaky tests that pass and fail randomly
cases.expected_output: Should reference A6 test diagnosis patterns
